repeatability.scope: Response text excludes timestamps, durations and other API envelope fields; observed pair only.

field_notes.missing_exit_code: Unavailable or not reached; not a successful exit.
field_notes.failure_category: Original trusted ledger category; blocked execution is not silently reclassified.
field_notes.real_prompt_hash: Hash of published redacted prompt, not original private request.
field_notes.candidate_execution: Real candidate_executed source flag denotes builder completion and is false on crashes despite observed execution.
field_notes.token_limits: num_ctx and num_predict are token budgets, not GB of memory.
